text: Three lessons of planning are done. This is where Devon opens Setup and actually builds the Warranty_Claim__c object for the first time.
The object itself comes first, with reports, activities, and field history tracking enabled from the start.
Status__c and Region__c are built as picklists, Claim_Amount__c as Currency, and Issue_Description__c and Resolution_Notes__c as Long Text Area fields.
Two Lookup relationships -- to Account and to Contact -- tie every claim to the right customer, without controlling the claim's own sharing.
Next: building the sharing rule that puts the security plan from a few lessons back into practice.
